<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Track DBG_VALUEs of (unmodified) register units.</p>


<p>Each DBG_VALUE has an entry in this map for each unit it touches. The DBG_VALUE's entry consists of a pointer to the instruction itself, and a vector of registers referred to by the instruction that overlap the key register unit.</p>
